timing.method: Fresh page; goto(05,12), stop the automatic loop, unfreeze animation, and set zero steering. Three simulation/render/readback frames warm up the scene. Each of exactly eight measured frames times step(1,1/60), drawList(), and synchronous WebGL readPixels(1x1) together. The even-count median is the average of both middle values; every raw sample is retained.
timing.interpretation: One eight-sample run per variant on host SwiftShader CPU rendering. Fit samples have two distinct timing groups. No reliable speedup, sustained frame rate, or Android/device FPS is established.

authoredPoseWithinOneChannelLevel.rationale: A separate maximum-error bound on decoded 8-bit channels, not pixel identity. A one-level difference is consistent with render quantization; the cause is not proven by this bound.

authoredPoseComparison.note: Computed independently from the actual saved images while the original temporal run continues; original strict failure is preserved.

visualStatus: Not an exact or user-approved match. Distant foam connection and some fine reflection/color details remain different.
deviceStatus: Separate Android debug APK built and signatures/assets verified; no physical Android runtime or performance test.
